messages:
talia (docs): Hey team — I'm prepping a tiny PR to expand the Regions doc with deployment-mode columns, endpoints, and a short FAQ on data locality. Draft link when I open it. :memo:
hugo (eng-infra): Good. Can you include the per-region API hostnames? e.g. api.us.redwood.ai, api.eu.redwood.ai. Also we should mark any "beta" regions.
talia (docs): Yes — table will be: region | endpoint | hosted | dedicated | private (VPC/on-prem) | kms | notes. Planning to add Node + Python SDK snippets too.
mira (security): Wording: use "data locality" not "residency". Approved sentence you can paste: "We may process or store customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." Do not promise locality in public docs without Sales/DPA.
sam (sales): Add a small callout for enterprise: "Contractual locality available — contact sales" with a link to the sales intake.
hugo (eng-infra): Current hosted endpoints: us-west-2 -> api.us.redwood.ai, eu-west-1 -> api.eu.redwood.ai, ap-northeast-1 -> api.ap.redwood.ai. KMS wrapping for hosted: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Dedicated supports customer KMS; Private depends on customer.
talia (docs): Nice. For SDK snippet I'll use this pattern (python):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(region="eu-west-1", api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.text.generate("Hello")
```
talia (docs): And a node example:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood.Client({ region: 'ap-northeast-1', apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const r = await client.text.generate('hi')
```
mira (security): Also add a footnote for EU-Germany: DPA addendum required for contractual locality. I'll review PR to confirm exact DPA phrasing.
hugo (eng-infra): One more infra note: ap-southeast-1 dedicated is limited/beta until autoscaler flags are enabled. Mark that in the table.
talia (docs): Will add a migration checklist bullet for hosted->dedicated: update base URL, rotate API keys, update allowlist entries, and coordinate model pinning with SEs.
sam (sales): Can we include a tiny template line for customers to request contractual locality? e.g. "We'd like contractual data locality in eu-west-1" — so CS can copy/paste.
talia (docs): Good idea — will add a short email template. Planning to push in ~30m and tag legal + infra for review.
doc-bot: Reminder — PR tests will run after push.
talia (docs): Pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/840 — please leave quick reviews. Marking thread resolved unless blockers come up. :white_check_mark:
